headline: Variance appeals for a place of assembly at 653 Riverside St. and a public toilet at 131 Valley St.
summary: One appeal asks for a hardship variance to allow a place of assembly at 653 Riverside St., in an industrial zone that does not allow it. A second asks for a practical difficulty variance to reduce a front setback at 131 Valley St. so a public toilet can be built.
items: Hardship variance (ZBA-003731-2026) for 653 Riverside St., to allow a place of assembly in the I-M zone, which does not permit that use. Owner RD 653 Riverside LLC; representative Yves Kinioka.
Practical difficulty variance (ZBA-003733-2026) for 131 (51) Valley St., to reduce the minimum front setback from 20 feet to 1'10" for a public toilet. Representative Jodi Kurilla.
